encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: τῶν γὰρ μετ’ ἐμαυτὸν εἰκόνος καὶ μνημάτων
ἀεὶ καταφρονῶν ζῶν ἔχειν τι βούλομαι.

note.p: Stobaeus Floril. 123, 5 Λάωνος ἐκ Διαθηκῶν Α.
εἰκόνων Mein. ed. mai. — contemnit simulacra et monumenta mortuorum prae voluptatibus vitae.

lg.l: μὴ φεῦγ’· ὁ μὲν γὰρ χρηστός, ἡ δ’ ἐφίμερος.

note.p: [Dicaearchus] 1, 22 in C. Mueller. Geogr. min. I 104 γράφει (Λάων) ἐπαινῶν αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ λέγων τὴν ἀλήθειαν. μοιχὸς γὰρ ἁλοὺς ἀφείθη, μικροῦ διαφόρου τὸν ἀδικηθέντα ἐξαγοράσας· Βοιωτὸν κτλ.
ἐφίμερος Steph.] ἐφήμερος. extremis verbis (μοιχός κτλ.) non ipsum Laonem, sed adulterum quem in fabula induxerit significari monet Mein. I 492. 3. Pherecr. 160 ἤνπερ φρονῆς εὖ, φεῦγε τὴν Βοιωτίαν.
